reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A high-rise office building has a central required exit stair. Which design is source-backed as incorrect under the protected-exit rule?

options.text: A protected exit separation with at least 2-hour fire resistance
A protected exit enclosure serving many storeys with only 1-hour fire resistance
Openings protected by approved self-closing fire-resistive doors
Noncombustible construction supporting the protected exit separation

proposed.rationale: For exits connecting four or more storeys, RA 9514 requires at least two-hour fire resistance.
proposed.explanation: This aligns the high-rise stair question with RA 9514 Section 10.2.5.2(B).
